description: This plot illustrates the relationship between the number of queries used during inference and the MRR@10 metric for different DPR models. The x-axis represents the number of queries used during inference (S), with a linear scale, ranging from 1 to 10, and tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis represents the MRR@10 metric, with a linear scale, ranging from 33.0 to 36.0, and tick labels at intervals of 0.5. The plot displays four lines, each representing a different DPR model: DPR w/o query (black, solid line, no markers), DPR w/ corpus expansion (red, solid line, circle markers), DPR w/ document expansion (green, solid line, triangle markers), and DPR w/ asymmetric expansion (blue, solid line, star markers). The black line remains steady at approximately 34.2 across the x-axis. The red line starts at around 35.4 when the number of queries is 1 and increases to approximately 35.7 when the number of queries is 4, then remains relatively steady. The green line begins at around 34.9, increases to approximately 35.0 when the number of queries is 4, and then gradually declines to around 34.8 when the number of queries is 10. The blue line starts at around 34.7, peaks at approximately 35.1 when the number of queries is 3, and then declines to around 34.3 when the number of queries is 10.
